description: Elections Commission - K. A. I. Kumara of the Kotikawatta, Mulleriyawa Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of the member of United National Party - K. A. Hemasiri of the Kesbewa Urban Council has vacated his office of member of the United National Party
reasoning: This gazette content contains a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabha and Urban Council) due to ceasing membership in a political party. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral matters including candidate registrations, vacating of offices, and election-related declarations.
